customManagers.description: The deploy workflows install wrangler globally instead of from the lockfile, so the version is pinned inline and Renovate moves the pin

packageRules.description: Never auto-update the Android Gradle Plugin; it must track the installed Android Studio, not the latest release

pdfjs-dist is owned by the update-pdfjs-viewer workflow, which bumps it together with the viewer vendored under packages/pdfjs-viewer/viewer. pdf.js refuses to start when the two versions disagree, so a bare version bump is never a usable change
pnpm 12 ships native binaries instead of a JS implementation and publishes none for 32-bit ARM, which Dockerfile.legacy builds for. The last release that runs anywhere Node does is 11.x

brace-expansion is pinned per major in the pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides. v5 exports { expand } instead of a function, so minimatch below 10 throws at the first brace pattern; on minimatch@3 that breaks @electron/asar@3 and every electron-forge make, which only the nightly runs
The CodeMirror and Lezer runtimes are pinned together in the pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides, and a partial bump leaves two copies of a singleton in the tree
Group FullCalendar packages because mixed core versions make plugins incompatible.
Capacitor plugins peer-depend on @capacitor/core, and the native android and ios packages must match it, so the mobile app's Capacitor packages move in one PR
